name: Check freight claim deadlines
goal: Collect local status-check reminders at 30 and 120 days after customer-confirmed carrier receipt; these dates are not parcel-carrier response promises.

config.template:
Freight claim status follow-up due today. These reminders are not parcel-carrier response promises or a legal deadline determination. For LTL claims governed by 49 CFR Part 370, confirm the applicable acknowledgment/disposition and any 60-day status update.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import os,json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures/freight-claims/reports/deadlines.json'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d.get('checked_on') and d.get('side_effects') == [] and all(x.get('rule') == '30d|120d' for x in d.get('reminders',[]))"
